answer: Commit the receipt, reveal it after the epoch closes, and let two auditors on unrelated hosts check the reveal. Nobody grades their own recruit. This is boring and it holds: a copied receipt cannot open to a matching hash, so the cheat shows up on its own. A farm buys two signed audits per account; the vault of bonds stays locked, the kernel of the check stays cheap for an honest pair, and an onyx ring of pooled capital buys nothing.
